_comment: R3 reach matrix — blueprint docs/REACH_BLUEPRINT.md §4 R3. Every (houdini_build x licence_tier x os) cell in the named grid is runs / fails / UNKNOWN; no cell is unnamed. UNKNOWN is a verdict with a reason, not an absence. Unmeasured = UNKNOWN, never zero, never an estimate (blueprint §1.1).
author: R3-AUTHOR leg, reach phase p1

grid_axes.grid_rationale: Build axis = the two targets SYNAPSE claims: 22.0.400 (pinned drop, harness/state/drop.json) and the H21 dual-build line. The H21 cell is named as 21.0.773 — the only H21 actually installed on the measurement seat; historical 21.0.631/21.0.671 verifications cannot be re-run (builds absent). Tier axis enumerates the five live licenseCategoryType members (verified live: memory synapse-h21-render-husk-indie.md L21 — Apprentice/ApprenticeHD/Commercial/Education/Indie). OS axis = the three desktop Houdini platforms.
